## Task 1 · The network of a café (2 marks)

A café has one box from the ISP, two PCs with cables, and Wi-Fi for the
guests.

a) Which job of the box joins the cables of the PCs? Which job gives the
Wi-Fi? Which job connects the café to the ISP? (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

b) A guest's phone shows the address **192.168.4.27** and the gateway
**192.168.4.1**. Is the address private or public? What is the gateway?
(1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

## Task 2 · An online race (3 marks)

The racing game *Moon Racer* sends the positions of the cars **20 times per
second**, and the players can buy new cars in the shop.

a) Which protocol carries the positions, and which the purchases? Why?
(1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

b) The game knows only the name **race.example.org**. What finds its IP
address? (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

c) A player has **300 Mbit/s**, but the ping is 41, 190, 44 ms and **25 %**
of the packets are lost. Is the network good for the race? Name the
problem. (1 mark)
